cases.title: A calm isometric line film routes to the Hairline kit with a tour and a composed rest

turns.prompt: @FrameCore Works Creative Studio Zrób 8-sekundową animację do reelsa: izometryczny rysunek liniowy szafki z szufladami w stylu cienkiej kreski, bez poświaty, gdzie szuflady wysuwają się po kolei.

items.item: Uses the Hairline kit, not Iso Glow, because the brief asks for no glow
items.reason: The assistant builds on HairlineKit (hairline-kit.js), reads its instructions and code, and uses its helpers (frame, solid, put, springAt, tourAt). Iso Glow is never mentioned or used, and the stroke-only styling with no glow fits the brief.

items.item: Plans the object's giveaway features, a composed rest with one bright mark and a tour of a few stops before building
items.reason: The plan comes before the code. It has a timeline with a draw-on phase, a rest at 1.3–1.5 s where only the top handle is bright, and five drawers opening in sequence. It names the components that identify the object (plinth, body, top slab, drawers, handles) and explains the uneven drawer heights as a deliberate choice. It does not use the phrase 'giveaway features'.

items.item: Moves everything as functions of time (no requestAnimationFrame) and renders or states how to render
items.reason: The visible code drives everything from renderFrame(t) using tourAt(t, TOUR), springAt(t, ...), and easeOut/prog(t, a, b). There is no requestAnimationFrame. The assistant states the render is NOT VERIFIED and gives setup steps (save index.html next to hairline-kit.js). The code is cut off mid-line, so the render driver at the end is not visible and cannot be confirmed.
